summary: A sign-preserving bijection exists by counting; with it both sides are equal signed spaces.

steps.claim: There is a bijection τ of the index sets preserving the signs (exists_equiv_of_card_neg): both index sets have the same size (t odd) and the same number of minus signs (card_neg_gridSigns).
With τ, the two spaces are signed spaces with the same signs, equal after reindexing (cases on j).
steps.lean: fun _ ↦ (⟨·, by cases j <;> exact signedSpace_eq_reindex _ rfl⟩)
